operations.name: Atom payloads
operations.notes: Atom is not served. At 2023-11-03, recorded Atom Accept and $format=atom requests return 415 AtomFormatNotSupported in OData XML; an Atom request body with JSON Accept returns the same status and code in negotiated OData JSON. Only JSON payloads are supported for Table catalog and entity operations.

operations.name: Bearer token authorization
operations.notes: Accepted with --oauth basic (audience, issuer, and times are checked but the signature is not, loopback only) or --oauth jwks (RS256 against a JWKS, role claims honored); with --oauth off a bearer token answers 401 InvalidAuthenticationInfo.

operations.name: Create Table
operations.notes: POST /Tables. Honors Prefer: return-content (201 with body, the default) and return-no-content (204 with Preference-Applied). Names are 3-63 alphanumerics starting with a letter, case-insensitive for uniqueness, 'tables' reserved (400 InvalidResourceName); an existing name returns 409 TableAlreadyExists.

operations.name: Delete Entity
operations.notes: DELETE with If-Match (* for unconditional) returns 204. A request without If-Match returns 400 InvalidInput; a missing entity returns 404 ResourceNotFound and a stale ETag 412.

operations.name: Delete Table
operations.notes: DELETE /Tables('name') returns 204 and removes the table and its entities immediately; there is no asynchronous TableBeingDeleted window. Missing tables return 404 ResourceNotFound in the negotiated OData JSON.

operations.name: Entity Group Transactions
operations.notes: POST /$batch with multipart/mixed: one change set of at most 100 insert, update, merge, upsert and delete operations on one table and partition, applied in a single SQLite transaction (all or nothing), or one lone query. A failing operation returns 202 with one failed part (actual status and an 'N:' message prefix naming the zero-based index; Content-ID echoed). Cross-partition and duplicate-row violations are reported the same way. Differences: all operations are parsed and validated before any executes, so a structural error at a later index can be reported ahead of an execution error at an earlier one; the 4 MiB payload bound is a 5 MiB request body bound; multiple change sets are rejected.

operations.name: Get Table ACL
operations.notes: GET /{table}?comp=acl returns the stored access policies as XML. Policy times are returned normalized to YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.fffffffZ. SAS tokens cannot read ACLs.

operations.name: Get Table Service Properties
operations.notes: GET /?restype=service&comp=properties returns the stored Logging, HourMetrics, MinuteMetrics and Cors sections (Azure defaults until set). Logging and metrics are stored and returned but not produced; CORS rules are enforced for preflights and normal requests.

operations.name: Get Table Service Stats
operations.notes: Answered on the primary endpoint and on the '<account>-secondary' path form with Status live and the current time as LastSyncTime. There is no geo-replication; the secondary form accepts GET only.

operations.name: Insert Entity
operations.notes: POST /{table} with nometadata, minimalmetadata and fullmetadata JSON; Prefer return-content (201) or return-no-content (204) with ETag, Location and DataServiceId headers. Enforces key characters and 1024-character keys, 252 user properties, 64 KiB strings and binary values, a 1 MiB entity, and the 400 codes PropertiesNeedValue, InvalidInput, PropertyNameInvalid, PropertyNameTooLong, PropertyValueTooLarge, TooManyProperties, EntityTooLarge, DuplicatePropertiesSpecified and InvalidValueType. Null values are not stored. A client-sent Timestamp is ignored. Existing entities return 409 EntityAlreadyExists.

operations.name: Insert Or Merge Entity
operations.notes: MERGE or PATCH without If-Match creates the entity or merges into it and returns 204. SAS tokens need both add and update permissions.

operations.name: Insert Or Replace Entity
operations.notes: PUT without If-Match creates or replaces the entity and returns 204. SAS tokens need both add and update permissions.

operations.name: Merge Entity
operations.notes: MERGE and PATCH (and POST with X-HTTP-Method) with If-Match merge the supplied properties into the stored entity and return 204. Null properties never remove stored ones. Missing entities return 404 and stale ETags 412.

operations.name: Preflight Table Request
operations.notes: OPTIONS on any table URL is answered from the account's stored CORS rules, matched with the Blob service's code: a missing Origin or Access-Control-Request-Method is 400 MissingRequiredHeader, no matching rule is 403 CorsPreflightFailure. Responses to requests with an Origin that a rule allows carry Access-Control-Allow-Origin and the exposed headers. Error bodies are the Table JSON form and have not been compared with Azure.

operations.name: Query Entities
operations.notes: GET /{table}() and GET /{table}(PartitionKey='p',RowKey='r') with $filter (eq ne gt ge lt le and or not, parentheses, at most 15 comparisons, string/Int32/Int64/Double/Boolean/DateTime/Guid/Binary literals), $select (absent properties are null), $top (maximum 1000) and NextPartitionKey/NextRowKey continuation. The incomplete-filter Azure recording checks 400 InvalidInput in negotiated OData JSON with the missing operand's position. Successful entity queries and filter functions are not recorded. Differences: comparisons require identical Edm types (an Int64 property never equals an Int32 literal), keys sort by UTF-8 bytes rather than UTF-16, a missing property matches only ne, there is no 5 second query timeout or partition-boundary short page, and $orderby, $skip, $expand, $count and filter functions return 501 or 400. A service SAS with spk/epk limits results to its range.

operations.name: Query Tables
operations.notes: GET /Tables with $filter on TableName, $top (default and maximum 1000) and NextTableName continuation (x-ms-continuation-NextTableName). Results are ordered by case-folded table name. GET /Tables('name') returns one table or 404 ResourceNotFound in the negotiated OData JSON. A service SAS cannot list tables.

operations.name: Set Table ACL
operations.notes: PUT /{table}?comp=acl stores up to five policies (permissions drawn from r, a, u, d; unique ids of at most 64 characters) and returns 204. An empty body clears all policies. Stored policies take effect for service SAS tokens that reference them with si.

operations.name: Set Table Service Properties
operations.notes: PUT /?restype=service&comp=properties replaces the supplied top-level sections, keeps the others, and returns 202. Sections are stored as sent after XML well-formedness checks; only the Cors element is validated (valid methods, at most five rules, else 400 InvalidXmlDocument), and only CORS is acted on.

operations.name: Update Entity
operations.notes: PUT /{table}(PartitionKey,RowKey) with If-Match (* or an ETag) replaces all properties and returns 204 with the new ETag. A missing entity returns 404 ResourceNotFound and a stale ETag 412 UpdateConditionNotSatisfied; If-None-Match is rejected with 400 InvalidInput. Weak, strong and percent-encoded forms of the Timestamp ETag all match.
